entries.title: Matthew 16:1
segments: Here the Pharisees and Sadducees came up, and, to test Jesus, requested him to show them some sign from the heavens.

entries.title: Matthew 16:2
segments: But Jesus answered: ["In the evening you say 'It will be fine weather, for the sky is as red as fire.'

entries.title: Matthew 16:3
segments: But in the morning you say 'To-day it will be stormy, for the sky is as red as fire and threatening.' You learn to read the sky; yet you are unable to read the signs of the times!]

entries.title: Matthew 16:4
segments: A wicked and unfaithful generation is asking for a sign, but no sign shall be given it except the sign of Jonah." So he left them and went away.

entries.title: Matthew 16:5
segments: Now the disciples had crossed to the opposite shore, and had forgotten to take any bread.

entries.title: Matthew 16:6
segments: Presently Jesus said to them: "Take care and be on your guard against the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

entries.title: Matthew 16:7
segments: But the disciples began talking among themselves about their having brought no bread.

entries.title: Matthew 16:8
segments: On noticing this, Jesus said: "Why are you talking among yourselves about your being short of bread, O men of little faith?

entries.title: Matthew 16:9
segments: Do not you yet see, nor remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took away?

entries.title: Matthew 16:10
segments: Nor yet the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you took away?

entries.title: Matthew 16:11
segments: How is it that you do not see that I was not speaking about bread? Be on your guard against the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

entries.title: Matthew 16:12
segments: Then they understood that he had told them to be on their guard, not against the leaven of bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

entries.title: Matthew 16:13
segments: On coming into the neighborhood of Caesarea Philippi, Jesus asked his disciples this question--"Who do people say that the Son of Man is?"

entries.title: Matthew 16:14
segments: "Some say John the Baptist," they answered, "Others, however, say that he is Elijah, while others again say Jeremiah, or one of the Prophets."

entries.title: Matthew 16:15
segments: "But you," he said, "who do you say that I am?"

entries.title: Matthew 16:16
segments: And to this Simon Peter answered: "You are the Christ, the Son of the Living God."

entries.title: Matthew 16:17
segments: "Blessed are you, Simon, Son of Jonah," Jesus replied. "For no human being has revealed this to you, but my Father who is in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 16:18
segments: Yes, and I say to you, Your name is 'Peter--a Rock, and on this rock I will build my Church, and the Powers of the Place of Death shall not prevail over it.

entries.title: Matthew 16:19
segments: I will give you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven. Whatever you forbid on earth will be held in Heaven to be forbidden, and whatever you allow on earth will be held in Heaven to be allowed."

entries.title: Matthew 16:20
segments: Then he charged his disciples not to tell any one that he was the Christ.

entries.title: Matthew 16:21
segments: At that time Jesus Christ began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem, and undergo much suffering at the hands of the Councillors, and Chief Priests, and Teachers of the Law, and be put to death, and rise on the third day.

entries.title: Matthew 16:22
segments: But Peter took Jesus aside, and began to rebuke him. "Master," he said, "please God that shall never be your fate!"

entries.title: Matthew 16:23
segments: Jesus, however, turning to Peter, said: "Out of my way, Satan! You are a hindrance to me; for you look at things, not as God does, but as man does."

entries.title: Matthew 16:24
segments: Then Jesus said to his disciples: "If any man wishes to walk in my steps, let him renounce self, and take up his cross, and follow me.

entries.title: Matthew 16:25
segments: For whoever wishes to save his life will lose it, and whoever, for my sake, loses his life shall find it.

entries.title: Matthew 16:26
segments: What good will it do a man to gain the whole world, if he forfeits his life? or what will a man give that is of equal value with his life?

entries.title: Matthew 16:27
segments: For the Son of Man is to come in his Father's Glory, with his angels, and then he 'will give to every man what his actions deserve.'

entries.title: Matthew 16:28
segments: I tell you, some of those who are standing here will not know death till they have seen the Son of Man coming into his Kingdom."
